name: Grandma's Wallet
description: A wallet whose owner key can be replaced by a trusted recoverer, but only after a recovery request has stayed unchallenged on chain for a set delay. The owner spends alone in normal use and can cancel a request at any time before the delay ends. Funds and savings positions stay where they are when the owner key changes.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Holds the owner key. Spends from the wallet, cancels recovery requests and changes the recovery settings.

recoverer.name: Recoverer
recoverer.description: A trusted person or service that can install a new owner key after an unchallenged delay. Cannot spend the wallet's funds.

createWallet.name: Set up wallet
createWallet.description: Create the wallet with its recovery settings and first funds. The recoverer does not need to take part.

send.name: Send
send.description: Pay from the wallet. If a recovery request is pending, sending also cancels it.

cancelRecovery.name: Cancel recovery
cancelRecovery.description: Cancel a pending recovery request. The wallet stays with its current owner.

approve.name: Approve
approve.description: Approve a transaction that spends outputs of an application bound to this wallet, such as a savings jar. The application's own rules still apply. If a recovery request is pending, approving also cancels it.

updateRecovery.name: Change recovery settings
updateRecovery.description: Replace the owner key, the recoverer or the challenge delay. Cancels any pending recovery request. The fee is paid from funds outside the wallet.

requestRecovery.name: Request recovery
requestRecovery.description: Ask for the wallet to be handed to a new owner key. The new owner's device joins to provide its key. The request can be completed only after the challenge delay, and the current owner can cancel it until then.

recoverer.name: Open the request
recoverer.description: Open the recovery request and pay its fee.

owner.name: Become the new owner
owner.description: Create the key that will own the wallet once recovery is complete.

finalizeRecovery.name: Complete recovery
finalizeRecovery.description: Install the new owner key named in the recovery request. Possible only when the challenge delay has passed without the request being cancelled.

createWalletTransaction.name: Wallet set up
createWalletTransaction.description: The wallet was created with $(<receivedSatoshis>) satoshis.

sendTransaction.name: Sent
sendTransaction.description: $(<sentSatoshis>) satoshis were sent from the wallet.

cancelRecoveryTransaction.name: Recovery cancelled
cancelRecoveryTransaction.description: A recovery request was cancelled by the owner.

approveTransaction.name: Approved
approveTransaction.description: The owner approved a transaction for an application bound to this wallet.

updateRecoveryTransaction.name: Recovery settings changed
updateRecoveryTransaction.description: The owner changed the wallet's recovery settings.

requestRecoveryTransaction.name: Recovery requested
requestRecoveryTransaction.description: The recoverer asked for the wallet to be handed to a new owner key.

finalizeRecoveryTransaction.name: Recovery completed
finalizeRecoveryTransaction.description: The wallet now belongs to the new owner key.

ownerControllerInput.name: Owner approval
ownerControllerInput.description: The wallet's controller, approving this transaction for the owner.

updateControllerInput.name: Owner approval
updateControllerInput.description: The wallet's controller, taking new recovery settings from the owner.

claimControllerInput.name: Recovery request
claimControllerInput.description: The wallet's controller, recording a recovery request by the recoverer.

finalizeControllerInput.name: Recovery completion
finalizeControllerInput.description: The wallet's controller, spent only after the challenge delay.

walletInput.name: Wallet funds
walletInput.description: Funds held by the wallet. Released by the owner's approval on the controller; they need no signature of their own.

newControllerOutput.name: Wallet controller
newControllerOutput.description: Records the wallet's owner, its recoverer and the challenge delay.

activeControllerOutput.name: Wallet controller
activeControllerOutput.description: The controller, unchanged apart from any recovery request being cleared.

pendingControllerOutput.name: Wallet controller
pendingControllerOutput.description: The controller with a recovery request waiting out the challenge delay.

nextControllerOutput.name: Wallet controller
nextControllerOutput.description: The controller with its new owner or recovery settings.

controllerLockingScript.name: Wallet controller
controllerLockingScript.description: Holds the wallet's identity token and enforces who may act for the wallet and when.

walletLockingScript.name: Wallet funds
walletLockingScript.description: The wallet's receiving address. Spendable only in a transaction the wallet's current owner approves.

ownerKey.name: Owner key
ownerKey.description: The key that controls the wallet in normal use.

recovererKey.name: Recovery key
recovererKey.description: The key the recoverer uses to request and complete recovery.

identity.name: Wallet identity
identity.description: The token category that identifies the wallet for its whole life.

controllerState.name: Current controller state
controllerState.description: The 69-byte state currently held by the wallet's controller.

nextControllerState.name: New controller state
nextControllerState.description: The 69-byte state the controller will hold after this transaction.

ownerKeyHash.name: Owner key hash
ownerKeyHash.description: Hash of the owner's public key.

recovererKeyHash.name: Recovery key hash
recovererKeyHash.description: Hash of the recoverer's public key.

proposedOwnerKeyHash.name: New owner key hash
proposedOwnerKeyHash.description: Hash of the public key that will own the wallet if recovery completes.

newOwnerKeyHash.name: Owner key hash after the change
newOwnerKeyHash.description: Hash of the owner's public key once the new settings apply.

newRecovererKeyHash.name: Recovery key hash after the change
newRecovererKeyHash.description: Hash of the recoverer's public key once the new settings apply.

challengeDelay.name: Challenge delay
challengeDelay.description: How long a recovery request must stay unchallenged, as a 3-byte relative locktime.

newChallengeDelay.name: Challenge delay after the change
newChallengeDelay.description: The challenge delay once the new settings apply, as a 3-byte relative locktime.

challengeSequence.name: Challenge delay as a sequence number
challengeSequence.description: The wallet's challenge delay in the form a completing transaction must carry.

controllerSatoshis.name: Controller amount
controllerSatoshis.description: The small amount of satoshis the controller carries. It never decreases.

sentSatoshis.name: Amount to send
sentSatoshis.description: Satoshis to pay to the recipient.
